means.example-sentence: On Friday evenings, there is a ceremony which is held every week without fail.
means.sentence-jp: 金曜日の夜に、毎週必ず開かれる儀式がある。

cloze.maskedText: On Friday evenings, there is a ceremony which is held every week ____.

notes: 命令形では「高圧的に」響きかねないので、多用は慎む。代わりに be sure to do, don't forget to do などを使う。
